attributes.residual: REGISTER_ONLY, machine-provable, WEBFRANK-READY. A clean 3-cycle permutation over the caller-saved registers r4/r5/r6, with r3 (the exp parameter), r7 (lv), r0 and the ctr loop all already matching. Exactly: target binds `rate` (initialised by `li r4,2970`, decremented by `addi r4,r4,-30` at the loop tail) to r4, the hoisted high half of the 0x28550 constant (`lis r5,3`, consumed by `addi rN,r5,-31408`) to r5, and `need` to r6; ours binds them r6, r4, r5 respectively, i.e. the cycle r4->r6->r5->r4. That accounts for all 18 real lines across `li rX,2970`, `lis rX,3`, `addi rX,r7,-1`, `addi r0,rX,1000`, `mullw rX,rX,r0`, `addi rX,rY,-31408`, `add rX,rX,r0`, `cmpw r3,rX` and `addi rX,rX,-30`. Instruction count is exact at 24/24, the opcode multiset is IDENTICAL, and the ctr-loop structure and both branch targets match, so this is a pure register renaming with no schedule or structural component. Note one of the three registers is a compiler-materialized constant with no source variable behind it, which is why source-level identity levers cannot reach the full cycle.
